answers.sql: SELECT e_h1.amount_million - e_q2.amount_million AS value FROM expenses e_h1, expenses e_q2 WHERE e_h1.entity = 'Tesla' AND e_h1.period = 'H1' AND e_h1.year = 2024 AND e_h1.metric = 'R&D' AND e_q2.entity = 'Tesla' AND e_q2.period = 'Q2' AND e_q2.year = 2024 AND e_q2.metric = 'R&D'

SELECT (e_q2.amount_million - (e_h1.amount_million - e_q2.amount_million)) * 100.0 / (e_h1.amount_million - e_q2.amount_million) AS value FROM expenses e_h1, expenses e_q2 WHERE e_h1.entity = 'Tesla' AND e_h1.period = 'H1' AND e_h1.year = 2024 AND e_h1.metric = 'R&D' AND e_q2.entity = 'Tesla' AND e_q2.period = 'Q2' AND e_q2.year = 2024 AND e_q2.metric = 'R&D'
